item.title: Destroy Flock Surveillance Cameras for Cash in GTA V
item.description: Artist Morry Kolman's GTALPR mod adds 235 Flock ALPR cameras to GTA V, letting players smash them for $600 each—a satirical jab at real‑world surveillance.
